details.title: Scaled Dot-Product Attention on a 2 by 2 Toy
details.idea: Query rows and key rows are vectors; S[i][j] is the dot product of query row i with key row j, each score becomes a weight w[i][j] after scaling and row-wise softmax, and the output row i is the weighted sum of the value entries.
details.audience: Engineering undergraduate familiar with algebra, meeting attention symbols for the first time

details.plan: Compute scaled dot-product attention for a fixed 2 by 2 query and key matrix and a 2 by 1 value matrix, showing raw dot products, scaled scores, row-wise softmax weights and the resulting output. The scaling toggle isolates the 1/sqrt(d_k) factor, and two presets contrast equal scores with a dominant score.
